description: Invoices, newest first. Optional: status ('draft'|'sent'|'paid'|'cancelled'), lead_id, account_id, contact_id, offer_id, search over number/title/recipient, limit (default 50). Each row carries due_on and overdue, both derived from the issue date — never stored, so they cannot go stale. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_invoices
